hollowengine.gui.rig_editor.generate_rag: Fill in a ragdoll from the model's geometry
hollowengine.gui.rig_editor.physics.body: Which colliders on this bone the body is made of. Several make one body; with none ticked off, the body takes them all, new ones too.
Kilograms per cubic metre. Flesh and bone together are a little denser than water.
How quickly the body loses speed on its own. Higher settles it sooner.
How quickly the body stops spinning on its own.
How much gravity pulls on this body. 0 leaves it floating, 2 makes it fall twice as hard.
How much the body grips what it slides along.
How much the body bounces off what it hits. 0 is a sack, 1 is a ball.
hollowengine.gui.rig_editor.physics.coll: Whether this body may hit the other bodies of the same model at all.
Bones this body always passes through, whatever else is set here.
Push apart the bodies this one already overlaps where the model stands. Off by default.
How hard the body resists what it touches. 1 is solid, lower lets other bodies sink into it and climb out slowly, 0 lets them pass straight through.
hollowengine.gui.rig_editor.physics.axis: How far the bone may turn one way, in degrees. Leave both at zero to lock the axis.
How far the bone may turn the other way, in degrees.
hollowengine.gui.rig_editor.physics.limi: How far the bone may turn around its own X, in degrees.
How far the bone may turn around its own Y, in degrees.
How far the bone may turn around its own Z, in degrees.
hollowengine.gui.rig_editor.physics.join: The bone whose body this one hangs from. Empty means the nearest one above it.
Where on this bone the joint sits, measured from the bone's own origin.
hollowengine.gui.rig_editor.collider.sha: Which side of the box the shape stands along; it is as thick as the thinner of the other two.
Corners of the hull, from -1 to 1 along each side of the box, so the hull grows and turns with it.
